primeTime.selectionMethod: 40% playoff-chase pressure near a .500 record; 30% projected closeness; 30% combined season PF. Editorial analysis, not playoff odds.

archive.headline: One win separates them. One week changes the chase.
Speed Kills meets the PF leader—with one win between them.

trashTalk.headline: All gas. No paper crowns.

lines.text: Speed Kills—163.76 last week. Was that horsepower, or did you use up the whole tank?
PaperChamp leads the league in PF. Cute résumé. Now keep that paper crown from getting run over.

trashTalk.closer: One win apart. Two loud team names. Somebody’s group chat is going quiet. 😂

archive.headline: Same record. One win on the line.

trashTalk.headline: Two 5–4 teams, one set of bragging rights

lines.text: PaperChamp, you’ve got 1,086.06 points in the bank. After last week’s loss, let’s see if that balance can buy a win.
Rolltide, ESPN’s got you up by 2.59. That’s barely a ripple—bring the whole tide this week.

trashTalk.closer: Same record, same pressure. Somebody’s bringing receipts on Tuesday. 😂

trashTalk.headline: One win apart. No room for quiet football.

lines.text: Canadian Content, 142.84 last week got you back to 5–5. Keep exporting points—nobody ordered another loss.
Rolltide, you took Primetime with 95.52. Bring more than a ripple this week—Canada just put up 142.84.

trashTalk.closer: One team wants to catch up. The other wants breathing room. Somebody is leaving with quieter notifications. 😂

trashTalk.headline: Same record. One statement.

lines.text: Rolltide, Canada sent you home with a 108.56-point receipt. At 6–5, bring a bigger wave this week.
Speed Kills, 1,265.34 PF looks fast. That 6–5 record still has you parked beside Rolltide.

trashTalk.closer: Both lost last week. Both want the last word. Somebody is getting left on read. 😂
